errors.text_span: по оста X стойностите са изписани до маркерите
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the values of the X-axis (years) are written next to the markers. In fact, the values of the Y-axis (number of countries) are written next to the markers.
The structure of listing the data points as Y-value followed by (X-value) is unconventional and can be slightly confusing for data presented in a time series chart, where (X, Y) is the standard.
